esimDescription: Review the eSIM hardware state and manage installed profiles.
esimErrorBody: The device did not return a valid eSIM status. Retry when the modem is ready.
esimDeleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. The profile must be installed again to use it.
overviewDescription: Check connectivity, notifications, and modem state in one place.
apModeDescription: Connect to the SMS-Forwarder-XXXXXX WiFi network with password sms-forwarder-setup, then open
overviewQuickDescription: Queries communicate directly with the current WiFi or cellular modem.
notificationDescription: Configure heartbeat, SMTP, and up to five external push channels.
notificationLocaleHint: The device uses this language for notification text.
heartbeatDescription: Send a periodic device-online notification through the configured notification channels. It includes the local number, network address, device address, and a note.
heartbeatNtpDescription: Heartbeat scheduling starts only after the device completes NTP synchronization.
keepaliveUnsupportedDescription: Cellular keepalive and 4G data are unsupported. This compatibility view cannot run keepalive or start cellular data.
keepaliveEnabledDescription: An older configuration left this setting enabled. Disable it to stop legacy scheduling; the stored interval and traffic values will remain unchanged.
keepaliveDisabledDescription: This setting is disabled. Its stored values are shown only for configuration compatibility.
emailDescription: Send a notification when an SMS arrives or settings change.
smtpPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
pushDescription: Each channel can use a different provider and credentials.
cellularPushDescription: Use the standard endpoint or set a separate endpoint for this channel over 4G.
cellularCaNotReady: Not ready; cellular delivery is paused
PUSH_CA_PROBE_READY: The endpoint certificate chain is ready for root selection.
PUSH_CA_PROBE_FAILED: The endpoint certificate chain could not be checked.
PUSH_CA_INSTALLED: The root CA is installed and verified.
PUSH_CA_STALE: The endpoint changed or the certificate check expired. Retry.
PUSH_CA_REJECTED: The device rejected all matching root CA candidates.
PUSH_CA_STORE_FAILED: The device could not store the verified root CA.
PUSH_CA_STATUS: The root CA status is current.
pushTestDescription: Send a test with the channel settings currently saved on the device. Unsaved edits are not used.
pushTestIdle: No test has run in this session.
customBodyHint: Place template values only inside JSON string values. You are responsible for the JSON structure.
sensitiveValueSavedHint: A saved value is configured. Leave this field blank to keep it.
templateDescription: Each push channel can override the default notification title and body.
templateValuesHint: Available values: {sender}, {message}, {timestamp}, {device} (device name), {localNumber}, {ip}, {hostname}, and {wifi} (Wi-Fi name). Device values that cannot be obtained are empty.
titleTemplateHint: Leave this value blank to use the default title.
bodyTemplateHint: Leave this value blank to use the default body.
messagingDescription: Send an SMS and manage the administrator, blocklist, and forwarding rules.
sendSmsDescription: Long messages are split automatically and sent through the cellular modem.
routingDescription: Keep a contact identifier and add one blocked number per line. SMS remote commands are disabled.
adminPhoneHint: Kept for contact identification. SMS remote commands are disabled.
blacklistHint: Enter one complete number per line.
forwardRulesDescription: Edit the exact rules used to route incoming messages.
forwardRulesHint: Use one tab-separated rule per line. Tabs and UTF-8 text are saved unchanged; invalid enabled regular expressions are rejected.
forwardRulesDialogDescription: Rules are checked from top to bottom. The first matching rule determines where the SMS goes.
forwardRulesSyntax: One line: type (kw, from, or re) ↹ pattern ↹ action [↹ enabled]. ↹ represents one Tab.
forwardRulesKeyword: kw finds case-sensitive literal text in the SMS body.
forwardRulesFrom: from matches the sender number with a case-insensitive regular expression.
forwardRulesRegex: re matches the SMS body with a case-insensitive regular expression.
forwardRulesActions: drop discards the SMS; email sends Email; 1–5 send to the matching push channel. Separate actions with commas; unknown actions are ignored.
forwardRulesPrecedence: Only the first matching rule is used. A rule containing drop discards the SMS immediately, so later rules are not checked.
forwardRulesEmpty: Blank lines, incomplete fields, and empty patterns are ignored. An omitted or blank enabled field means enabled; only 0 disables a rule. Blank or unknown actions select no destination.
forwardRulesEscaping: kw uses literal text; from/re use POSIX ERE. Backslashes follow regular-expression rules, including \d, \w, and \s. Tabs separate fields and cannot appear inside a field.
forwardRulesTabNotation: The examples use ↹ for one Tab.
deviceDescription: Manage device connectivity, diagnostics, maintenance, and advanced actions.
deviceSubpageConnectionDescription: Configure device identity, Wi-Fi profiles, and network mode.
deviceSubpageDiagnosticsDescription: Review device and modem status, then inspect recent activity.
deviceSubpageMaintenanceDescription: Back up or restore configuration, or install a signed update package.
deviceSubpageAdvancedDescription: Run controls and AT operations that may interrupt service.
deviceGroupDangerDescription: These actions can interrupt SMS reception or the administration page. Confirm before running them.
wifiProfilesDescription: Configure up to five saved networks. An empty SSID disables that slot. Saving a change reconnects WiFi.
wifiSsidHint: Leave blank to disable this profile.
wifiPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the saved password when the SSID is unchanged. New passwords must contain 8 to 63 printable ASCII characters.
wifiPasswordChangedHint: Enter a new 8 to 63 character printable ASCII password or explicitly select an open network. This is required when the SSID changes or an open network becomes secured.
networkModeHint: The preference is stored, but channels without CA setup will not send over cellular.
networkModeWarningDescription: Cellular delivery works only when 4G delivery is enabled for the channel and secure certificate setup is ready. If 4G delivery is disabled, the channel uses WiFi only. The device does not send while roaming. GET and ntfy can use cellular delivery under these conditions.
deviceHistoryDescription: Review recent device entries; auto-refresh runs only on this page.
deviceNameHint: This name identifies the device in the administration page.
hostnameHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Restart the device to apply this value.
atDescription: Send an AT command directly. Only run commands you understand.
otaDescription: Select one signed .smsota package from a project release.
demoDisabledBody: Connect to a device to use this operation.
controlWarning: These actions can interrupt SMS reception or the administration page.
confirmWifi: Reconnect WiFi? The administration page will briefly go offline.
confirmHardReset: Power cycle and restart the modem?
securityDescription: Manage up to ten HTTP Basic Auth accounts.
otaStateDescription: Check the running slot and the key identity accepted for signed updates.
otaStateUnsupported: This firmware does not expose update trust status yet.
otaStateUnavailable: Update trust status is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
otaStateKeyHint: A matching fingerprint means this firmware accepts the same signed update key. It does not identify a production or test build.
accountDescription: Leave a username blank to disable that account. After saving, use an enabled account for the next request.
passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password. A new account requires a password.
securityWarningBody: This page uses plain HTTP. Change the default password and never expose it directly to the Internet.
configFileDescription: The encrypted file contains WiFi, SMTP, and push credentials plus portable notification settings. Restore keeps this device name, hostname, and management accounts.
passphraseHint: Use at least 12 characters. The device does not store this passphrase.
providerHint1: POST the sender, message, and timestamp as JSON.
providerHint2: Use the Bark JSON API with a title and body.
providerHint3: Append SMS data to the URL query string.
providerHint4: Enter a DingTalk webhook. The Secret is optional.
providerHint5: Enter a PushPlus Token. Leave URL blank to use the default.
providerHint6: Enter a ServerChan SendKey. Leave URL blank to use the default.
providerHint7: Define a JSON body with replacement variables.
providerHint8: Enter a Feishu webhook. The Secret is optional.
providerHint9: Enter a Gotify server URL and application Token.
providerHint10: Enter a Telegram Chat ID and Bot Token.
providerHint11: POST the rendered title and body to a Discord webhook.
providerHint12: POST the rendered body to an ntfy topic URL with the rendered Title header.
keyTokenHint: The token issued by the push service.
keyChannelHint: Use wechat, extension, or app; blank uses wechat.
ACTION_CONFIG_SAVE_FAILED: Configuration could not be saved. Retry and verify after restarting the device.
ACTION_CONFIG_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Keep at least one management account.
ACTION_INPUT_TOO_LONG: The named field exceeds its UTF-8 byte limit.
ACTION_INPUT_INVALID: The named field contains invalid UTF-8 text or control characters.
ACTION_SMS_FAILED: SMS could not be sent. Check the modem state.
ACTION_PING_MODEM_ERROR: The modem returned an error while pinging.
ACTION_PING_UNREACHABLE: The ping target timed out or is unreachable.
ACTION_PING_TIMEOUT: No ping result was received before timeout.
ACTION_FLIGHT_STATUS_NORMAL: The modem is in full-function mode.
ACTION_FLIGHT_STATUS_OFF: The modem is in minimum-function mode.
ACTION_FLIGHT_STATUS_ON: The modem is in flight mode.
ACTION_FLIGHT_STATUS_UNKNOWN: The modem returned an unknown function mode.
ACTION_FLIGHT_FAILED: Flight mode could not be read or changed.
ACTION_AT_REJECTED: That command is not allowed from the Web terminal.
ACTION_AT_TIMEOUT: The AT command timed out without a response.
ACTION_MODEM_BUSY: The modem is busy. Try again later.
ACTION_MODEM_RESTARTING: The modem is restarting. Refresh in about 15 seconds.
ACTION_MODEM_HARD_RESTARTING: The modem is power cycling. Refresh in about 15 seconds.
ACTION_WIFI_RESTARTING: WiFi is reconnecting. Refresh in about 5 seconds.
ACTION_WIFI_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter a new 8 to 63 character printable ASCII WiFi password or explicitly select an open network. This is required when the SSID changes or an open network becomes secured.
ACTION_PASSPHRASE_INVALID: Enter matching passphrases of at least 12 characters.
ACTION_BACKUP_TOO_LARGE: The backup file is larger than 32,828 bytes.
ACTION_OTA_READY: The update passed validation. The device will restart.
ACTION_CSRF_INVALID: The request token expired. Refresh the page and retry.
ACTION_JOB_NOT_FOUND: The device no longer has this operation.
ACTION_AUTH_THROTTLED: Too many authentication attempts. Retry later.
ACTION_BUSY: The device is busy with another operation.
ACTION_CONFIG_EXPORT_FAILED: The device could not create the backup.
ACTION_CONFIG_EXPORT_NOT_FOUND: The backup download expired or does not exist.
ACTION_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE_INVALID: Use a passphrase of 12 to 128 bytes.
ACTION_CONFIG_RESTORE_CHUNK_INVALID: The backup chunk or offset is invalid.
ACTION_CONFIG_RESTORE_FAILED: The device could not restore the configuration.
ACTION_CONFIG_RESTORE_FINISH_INVALID: The backup upload is incomplete or expired.
ACTION_CONFIG_RESTORE_INVALID: The passphrase or backup file is invalid.
ACTION_CONFIG_RESTORE_SAVE_FAILED: The restored configuration could not be saved.
ACTION_CONFIG_RESTORE_START_FAILED: The backup upload could not start.
ACTION_JOB_QUEUE_FULL: The operation queue is full. Retry later.
ACTION_JSON_FAILED: The device could not create the JSON response.
ACTION_OTA_BEGIN_FAILED: The firmware writer could not start.
ACTION_OTA_BUSY: A firmware or configuration transfer is active.
ACTION_OTA_CHUNK_INVALID: The firmware chunk or offset is invalid.
ACTION_OTA_FINALIZE_FAILED: The firmware image could not be finalized.
ACTION_OTA_HASH_INVALID: The firmware hash does not match the signed manifest.
ACTION_OTA_MANIFEST_INVALID: The firmware manifest is invalid or incompatible.
ACTION_OTA_METADATA_FAILED: The update rollback metadata could not be saved.
ACTION_OTA_SESSION_INVALID: The firmware upload session is invalid or expired.
ACTION_OTA_WRITE_FAILED: The firmware chunk could not be written.
ACTION_TOO_MANY_FIELDS: The request contains too many fields.
ACTION_ESIM_BUSY: The eSIM or another device operation is busy.
ACTION_ESIM_HANDLE_STALE: The profile changed. Refresh the profile list and try again.
esimInstallDescription: Enter the activation code from your carrier. The installed profile will remain disabled.
esimConfirmationHelp: Your carrier requires this code. Submit it within five minutes. It is not saved.
esimConsentDescription: Check the carrier details and respond within five minutes.
ACTION_ESIM_POSTPONED: Installation was postponed. No profile was installed.
ACTION_ESIM_CANCELLATION_FAILED: The installation session could not be closed. Check the profile list and contact your carrier before reusing the activation code.
ACTION_ESIM_CONFIRMATION_STALE: This installation is no longer waiting for confirmation. Refresh its status.
ACTION_ESIM_NOTIFICATION_PENDING: The profile is installed. Server notification is pending. Do not reuse the activation code.
ACTION_ESIM_INSTALLATION_UNCERTAIN: Installation could not be confirmed. Check the profile list and contact your carrier before reusing the activation code.
